selected_evidence.requirement: Persistently disable IPv4 ICMP redirect and source-route acceptance
selected_evidence.summary: Initial insecure values were captured; persistent all/default/eth0 settings were installed; final post-reboot values are zero for all, default, eth0, and lo.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Ubuntu 7.10 and kernel 2.6.22-14-generic are unchanged across the final reboot.

Healthy baseline boot ID e454dd79-5fa8-4571-bda7-02569c27b753 was captured, reboot acknowledged, new boot ID 16bce796-6204-4c65-b635-168ca9576c91 observed, and post-restart sysctl, address, route, gateway reachability, and SSH recovery verified.

commands.command:
set -e
cp -p /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.conf.pre-kernel-network-hardening
cat >> /etc/sysctl.conf <<'ANTRIEB_HARDENING_EOF'

# Managed kernel network hardening: reject ICMP redirects and source routing
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 0
ANTRIEB_HARDENING_EOF
/sbin/sysctl -p /etc/sysctl.conf
for d in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*; do printf 0 > "$d/accept_redirects"; printf 0 > "$d/accept_source_route"; done
printf 'UPDATED_FILE_TAIL\n'; tail -10 /etc/sysctl.conf
printf 'LIVE_VALUES_AFTER_APPLY\n'; for d in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*; do n=${d##*/}; printf '%s redirects=' "$n"; cat "$d/accept_redirects"; printf '%s source_route=' "$n"; cat "$d/accept_source_route"; done
